all_time.scope: ESPN era + Sleeper era (published through 2025, plus Sleeper since)

asterisk_legend.*: 2019 and later only (Sleeper-era data). There is no ESPN-era data for these.

efficiency.note: A skill stat. Deliberately NOT part of Tegridy Factor.

faab_and_transactions.note: spent = winning bids in the transaction log, net of claims the commissioner later undid (refunded; e.g. the Sep 2021 week-1 corrections). Sleeper's own 'used' figure also reflects FAAB traded between owners and any budget edits that aren't in the log; unexplained_difference is what's left (positive = Sleeper shows more used than the log explains). faab_taken_as_penalty is FAAB the commissioner took for missed league notes (config/commissioner_penalties.json); remaining_unexplained is what's still unexplained after that (small corrections and refunds, mostly 2019 and 2021).

faab_efficiency.definition: Starting-lineup points a FAAB-acquired player scored for the owner, divided by the dollars bid. Only claims of $1+ count as paid; $0 claims are tracked separately. Bench points don't count. Claims the commissioner undid are ignored. Claims dropped before the player ever shows on a roster for a game week count as dollars spent with no return (outcome 'dropped_before_playing'). points_above_replacement (PAR) subtracts the position's replacement level for each week he started: the points per game of the (N+1)th best player at that position over the season, where N is the average number started league-wide per week (see replacement_levels). Bench stashes bought on purpose (handcuffs, injury stashes) still look like busts.
faab_efficiency.name: Bang for Buck

luck.note: Regular season. luck = actual wins minus wins expected from your scores vs. everyone each week.

record.note: 2019 and later only; the legacy-inclusive all-time record is in `all_time`. Postseason includes every playoff-week game (consolation and third-place included). Points come from the weekly matchups (commissioner-adjusted where set). Sleeper's own season standings totals differ slightly in a few seasons; each season object carries sleeper_standings_reported for comparison. Win-loss records match Sleeper exactly.
